category_seo.title: Blockchain Infrastructure - RPC Nodes, APIs & Data Services | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Infrastructure services for Web3 applications. RPC node providers, indexing services, data APIs, and decentralized storage solutions.

faqs.question: What is blockchain infrastructure?
faqs.answer: Blockchain infrastructure includes RPC nodes for blockchain access, indexers for querying data, IPFS/Arweave for decentralized storage, and oracles for off-chain data. These are the backbone of dApps.

faqs.question: Should I run my own node?
faqs.answer: For most projects, using a provider like Alchemy or Infura is more practical. Run your own node for maximum decentralization, specific customization needs, or archive data access.

faqs.question: What is The Graph used for?
faqs.answer: The Graph indexes blockchain data and provides GraphQL APIs. It makes querying on-chain data fast and efficient. Most major DeFi protocols use subgraphs for their frontends.
